plan.title: SRC-REV-026 Reverse Auction Price Increase Refusal

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation flow for a reverse auction.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the auction pricing template before adding line items.
Invite the QA vendor who will submit the bid.
Publish the auction so the vendor can bid.
Confirm the auction reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's separate portal session.
Open the live auction's vendor pricing sheet.
Submit a baseline bid value that can be used to test an increase refusal.
Confirm the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Attempt to revise the reverse-auction bid upward and assert Procol refuses it.
